why: The Kenmore Diner is the roadside diner under the Arroyo viaduct where Desperate Measures has V wait for the Zetatech transport. The building is base-world content: the kept open-world community phase already instantiates #arr_12_diner, so the interior, counter, booths and kitchen stream in without a quest. Its people are an ambient background crowd (two waitresses, day and night customer seats) that starts active in vanilla; this proposal re-issues those six entries so a fresh start inside the diner is staffed and seated. Nothing from the gig is restored: no road blocks, no guards, no loot, and the DLC prefab variant stays at its default 0.

open_questions: Walk into the Kenmore Diner from the viaduct side and confirm the interior is open, lit and furnished (counter, booths, kitchen) with no sealed or blocked entrance.

Count who is inside the diner at midday and again at night: expect the two waitresses plus seated customers; if the counter is empty, the background crowd is not spawning on a fresh start and the two boot/proximity activations need checking.
Look at the diner's street corner for leftover gig dressing: no orange Zetatech traffic barriers, no floating loot tokens, no Zetatech guards and no transport waiting at the intersection.
Check the diner's TV and camera are powered and interactable rather than left in a quest-disabled state (q003's TV refs collide with this diner's TV nodes).

communities.why: Female waitress on shift. default is the entry's only phase and its vanilla initial phase (entryActiveOnStart=1); her spots play diner 'stand_tablet taking_order' and 'stand mop cleaning_floor', i.e. serving and cleaning, never a combat or scene pose.
Male server behind the counter. default is his only phase and vanilla initial phase; his spots are 'stand_glass clean' at the bar and 'kneel_ground_tablet use', i.e. routine service work.
Daytime diner customer. default is the entry's only phase and vanilla initial phase; spot plays barstool/chair idles (eat takeout, drink, check phone) at the counter and booths.
Second daytime diner customer; same seat set as diner_customer_f_day and the same relaxed dining workspots. Vanilla starts the entry active in default.
Night-shift diner customer at the barstools; his three spots play sit_barstool sleep, check_phone and drink_vodka, i.e. a late patron. Vanilla starts the entry active in default.
Second night-shift customer; same three barstool spots as diner_customer_f_night and the same relaxed night workspots. Vanilla starts the entry active in default.

deferred_prefab_owner: world streaming (the chosen people need no quest prefab)

proximity_wait.why: The diner's surveillance camera is the only device the catalogue resolves inside this venue (path $/03_night_city/#c_santo_domingo/arroyo/loc_sts_std_arr_12_diner_prefabUU7T6KQ/loc_sts_std_arr_12_viaduct_devices_prefabFGOTLPQ/#arr_12_dvc_diner_camera), and it is a real device entity streamed with the diner's device prefab in the sector's base node range, so it is a valid non-workspot anchor.
